controls.label: Mood
controls.hint: A time of day, a cloud cover, a wind and a weather together. Picking one moves the sliders.

controls.label: Time of day
controls.hint: Hours, 0 to 24: the sun, the moon, the colours of the sky and the light on the clouds.

controls.label: Cloud cover
controls.hint: From a clear sky, through scattered cumulus at about half, to a closed deck.

controls.label: Wind
controls.hint: How fast the clouds drift and churn, and how much the lake ripples. At 0 the sky holds still.

controls.label: Rain
controls.hint: Streaks of rain round the camera. It rains from any sky, so pair it with cover for a real downpour.

controls.label: Wind direction
controls.hint: Where the wind blows to, in degrees.

controls.label: Puff size
controls.hint: Above 1, more and smaller clouds; below 1, fewer and bigger.

controls.label: Edge detail
controls.hint: The scale of the erosion that carves the clouds: low is soft and rounded, high is busy and torn.

controls.label: Cloud depth
controls.hint: How tall the cloud layer is, against what the weather asks for.

controls.label: Painted bands
controls.hint: Bands the light on the clouds into flat steps, for a more drawn look.

controls.label: Sun height
controls.hint: How high the sun gets at noon, in degrees.

controls.label: Cloud shadows
controls.hint: How dark the clouds' shadows lie on the land.

controls.label: Time passing
controls.hint: Runs the time of day on its own, a day in a minute, until turned off.

controls.label: Lightning by itself
controls.hint: Strikes every few seconds while the weather is a storm.

controls.label: Quality
controls.hint: How much the clouds spend. Auto starts at Medium and drops to Low if frames run slow. Changing it compiles nothing.

triggers.label: Lightning
triggers.hint: A strike somewhere in view, with the clouds lit round it.

triggers.label: Reset
triggers.hint: Everything back to the start: the mood, every slider and the view.
